title: Magical String
description:
The magical string contains only `1` and `2`. Reading the lengths of its consecutive runs produces the string itself. Its beginning is `122112122122112...`. Return the number of `1` characters among its first `n` characters.

## Examples

```text
Input: n = 6
Output: 3
```

```text
Input: n = 1
Output: 1
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= n <= 10^5`
